data.title: 天雨亚子 · 迎宾晚宴上的优雅行政官
data.description: 学园政商名流云集的迎宾大宴会厅，璀璨的水晶吊灯倾泻下万道流光。亚子换上一袭深蓝近夜色的露背晚礼服，白皙无瑕的美背在华灯下耀眼夺目。她优雅地端着香槟杯侧身回眸，看到携伴而来的老师时，端庄的面具下悄悄泛起了一抹羞涩的红晕。
data.action: 她优雅地端着香槟杯侧身回眸，看到携伴而来的老师时，端庄的面具下悄悄泛起了一抹羞涩的红晕
data.lighting: dazzling sparkling chandelier brilliance and warm golden banquet illumination
data.promptProse: Inside a grand academy banquet hall beneath sparkling crystal chandeliers, Amau Ako stands near the draped marble columns in her midnight-blue backless evening gown. Holding a tall flute of pale champagne by the stem, she turns back over her bare shoulder toward the viewer as a faint bashful blush breaks through her formal composure. Warm golden banquet light glints across her silver necklace, the polished floor, and the deep velvet curtains behind her.
data.animaCaption: Standing beneath the grand ballroom chandeliers in her midnight-blue backless gown, Ako holds a champagne flute and turns back over her bare shoulder with a bashful blush. Warm golden banquet light catches her silver necklace and the draped hall behind her.
